candidate: Compute the six squared distances to the query voxel faces once per nearest query. Reuse these values in the existing 26-neighbor traversal and retain the same three-axis ordered sum.
invariants: Same voxel divisions, floor/casts, strict comparisons, center-first dx/dy/dz traversal, point order, nearest distance arithmetic, thresholds, exact target counts, weights, H/b chunks/reduction, solver, stopping, map updates, dispatch and defaults.
selection: All 16 previous real recording cases in default and balanced modes: both recordings, both motion policies, raw and gyro, legacy and fine sampling. Reused development data; no blind holdout.
replay_scope: Complete native automatic register calls on preloaded scans; input loading, checks and serialization excluded.
replay_summary: Per case/mode/implementation median of six complete measured recording totals, then sum of case medians and candidate/baseline ratio. Retain all per-frame clocks, warmups, samples and regressions.
fixed_scope: 64 frozen real states (60 eligible plus 4 empty), 32 repetitions, one warmup and five measured blocks per process; report all stage and whole-H/b clocks.
validation: Strict original trajectory pose/threshold bits and termination/iteration equality; strict baseline/candidate complete numeric frame equality. All fixed-state pair rows and matrices checked against independent originals; strict cross-binary fixed-state validation bits.
builds: Fresh baseline and candidate source snapshots and native release builds. Never substitute the preceding comment-promoted binary for a current-main build.
limitations: Single host, uncontrolled CPU placement/frequency. No GPU, whole-application or accuracy gain established.
